title: Fruit Fly
author: Josh Silver
engineRationale: Literary satire/thriller with wholly fictional characters (Mallory Maddox, Leo) and no nameable real people to depict; the subject is internal and abstract (writer's block, addiction to validation, the ethics of harvesting someone else's pain) — flat-vector rigged everyman + kinetic typography portrays it, while photoreal Flux cut-outs of invented people read generic AND would be heavily CONTENT_FILTERED on the drug/sex-work/self-destruction beats.
paletteRationale: Overripe-fruit bruise: pale peach paper going soft, plum-black ink, raspberry accent, and a chartreuse fly-green secondary — no other book in the registry uses a green 'gold', so the thumbnail can't be mistaken for another video.
